newsitem.title: USA: Mitsuzuka says he, Waigel support stable dollar.
newsitem.headline: Mitsuzuka says he, Waigel support stable dollar.

text.p: Japanese Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka said on Sunday that he and German Finance Minister Theo Waigel agreed that the Group of Seven will cooperate to deal with some concerns about the strong dollar.

Emerging from a meeting with the German policymaker ahead of a G7 gathering on Sunday, Mitsuzuka told reporters that he and Waigel also agreed that G7 cooperation is necessary to achieve currency stability.
According to Mitsuzuka, Waigel supported Japan's efforts to seek economic growth led by domestic demand. The two men also agreed that economic reforms are important in both countries, Mitsuzuka said.
In his talks with Waigel, Mitsuzuka said he highlighted the importance of the February currency agreement of the G7, calling it an important factor for economic stability.
Under that pact, the G7 signalled their desire for currency stability by saying that the past excessive weakness of the dollar had been corrected.
